69 likes, 12 comments - ramit on October 19, 2026: "One thing you can’t stop thinking about. One thing you avoid thinking about. We’re covering both this week, live and free.

📌 STOP OVERTHINKING. START DRAWING AWAY ANXIETY
🗓️ Wed, Oct 21 at 3pm ET / 12pm PT (*time updated)
🗣️ With Harvard-trained clinical psychologist Lorwen Harris Nagle, PhD

Understanding your anxiety isn’t the same as stopping it. Sometimes the next step isn’t more analysis.
→ try a 90-second drawing exercise live (no artistic skill required)
→ learn why drawing works differently from going for a walk
→ leave with one thing to try the next time your brain won’t let something go

📌 HOW TO GET OUT OF DEBT AND STILL LIVE YOUR LIFE
🗓️ Thu, Oct 22 at 8pm ET / 5pm PT
🗣️ With me, Ramit

Start tonight: write down every debt you have, with the balance and interest rate. Then on Thursday, I’ll help you:
→ decide which debt to attack first
→ build a Conscious Spending Plan that pays it down automatically
→ keep spending on the things you love

🔗 Want both? Comment EVENTS and I’ll DM you both links. Only want one? Comment CALM or DEBT.".
